hero.subtitle: Accurate, consistent and compliance-aware translations for investment funds, asset managers and financial institutions.

expertise.heading: How we help you
expertise.intro: We focus exclusively on financial services translation, bringing deep financial knowledge and technical precision to every project.
expertise.card1_post: - prospectuses, KIIDs, supplements, annual reports, and investor communications. We understand the nuances that generic translation services miss.
expertise.card2_post: documentation across multiple European jurisdictions. We know what regulators expect and how to deliver it.
expertise.card3_body: Native-level translation with rigorous terminology management, deadline adherence, and regulatory awareness built into every step of our process. Quality that passes regulatory scrutiny.

why.heading: You can't just ask AI...
why.block1_pre: Translating regulated financial documents is not simply a linguistic exercise.
why.block1_bold: Inconsistent terminology, imprecise wording or a lack of regulatory awareness
why.block2_p1: Yes, AI and machine translation can do many things, we also use them! But for highly technical documents like annual reports, financial statements, or regulatory documents, it's best not to rely solely on computers.
why.block2_p2_pre: Just think of the many ways the word
why.block2_p2_post: can be translated without context! Human translators will always play a crucial role. And that’s where we come in...
why.highlight: Specialist financial translation, with the right mix of digital and human resources, makes all the difference.

hero.heading: About FINTRASC
hero.subtitle: Specialist translation services for investment funds and financial institutions

what_we_do.heading: What We Do
what_we_do.intro: We help investment funds and financial market participants translate key regulatory and investor-facing documents, including:
what_we_do.doc2_body: Key Investor Information Documents (KIIDs) and Key Information Documents (KIDs)
what_we_do.focus_body: Producing translations that are clear, precise and suitable for your investors and for regulatory review.

compliance.heading: A Compliance-Focused Approach
compliance.intro: We work with a strong understanding of the European regulatory environment for investment funds, including:
compliance.body: While we do not provide legal advice, our translations reflect the regulatory context in which these documents are used. Terminology is handled carefully, numerical information is checked thoroughly, and wording is aligned with common market practice and EU Directives or Regulations.
compliance.highlight: The result is translations designed to stand up to scrutiny.

esg.heading: ESG & Sustainability Disclosures
esg.body1: Sustainability and ESG disclosures require particular care. Ambiguous or promotional language can expose funds to regulatory and reputational risk.
esg.highlight: We translate sustainability disclosures with a conservative, accuracy-first approach
esg.body2: Ensuring that ESG terminology is used consistently and in line with regulatory expectations, while faithfully reflecting the source text.
esg.conclusion: This supports credible and compliant sustainability reporting across languages.

how_we_work.heading: How We Work
how_we_work.intro: Our process is designed to support accuracy, consistency and confidentiality
how_we_work.step1_body: Understanding the regulatory context, target audience and jurisdiction
how_we_work.step2_body: Ensuring consistency with existing fund documentation and prior disclosures
how_we_work.step3_body: Focused on financial and regulatory accuracy
how_we_work.step4_body: Terminology, figures and internal consistency checks
how_we_work.step5_body: Confidential handling and reliable turnaround times

who_we_work_with.heading: Who We Work With
who_we_work_with.cta: Whether you are launching a new fund, updating regulatory documentation or preparing sustainability disclosures, we provide translation services you can rely on.

info.card2_body: All documents and correspondence are handled with full discretion.
